lm.statistic: tone coefficient under circular shift of standardized tone
lm.shift_domain: retained analysis rows in session order, after eligibility
lm.reporting_note: Descriptive timing diagnostic reported as a percentile rank. It is NOT a p-value for H0: beta = 0 and is not assumption-free: shifting tone also destroys its relationship with the controls, so this is not the null distribution of the conditional coefficient. The inferential statement comes from the HAC interval alone. A shift of k positions is not a shift of k calendar sessions where the retained rows have gaps; n_gaps and largest_gap_sessions quantify that.
